name: response_quality
description: Clarity and calibration of general assistant responses.
instructions: Judge the complete assistant response for clarity, factual accuracy, and appropriate calibration. Reward direct explanations supported by the session, and penalize unsupported claims or assumptions presented as established facts.

metrics.name: clarity
metrics.description: The response directly explains the requested concept in understandable language.

metrics.name: calibration
metrics.description: The response separates established facts from assumptions and avoids unsupported claims.
